act_name: Pakistan Naval Academy (Award of Degrees) Ordinance, 1965
heading: Short title extend and commencement
title: Short title extend and commencement
text:
1. Short title extend and commencement.___(1) This Ordinance may be called the Pakistan Naval Academy (Award of Degrees) Ordinance, 1965.

(2) It shall come into force at once.

act_name: Pakistan Naval Academy (Award of Degrees) Ordinance, 1965
heading: Definitions
title: Definitions
raw_text:
2. Definitions. In this Ordinance, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or 
context,–– 
 
(a) 
“Cadet-entry Officer” means a person appointed as a cadet in any branch of the 
Pakistan Navy, and includes any such person promoted to the rank of 
midshipman or acting sub-lieutenant, while still undergoing the prescribed 
course; 
 
(b) 
“prescribed course” means a course of training prescribed by regulations made 
under this Ordinance.

act_name: Pakistan Naval Academy (Award of Degrees) Ordinance, 1965
heading: Conferment of degrees on Cadet
title: Conferment of degrees on Cadet
text: 3. Conferment of degrees on Cadet-entry Officers. The Pakistan Naval Academy shall have the power to confer the degree of the Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Arts, abbreviation whereof shall be B.Sc (N.A) or B.A (N.A.), respectively, and four years Bachelor of Studies in Naval and Management Sciences), on any Cadet-entry Officer on his successful completion of the prescribed course in the Pakistan Naval Academy appropriate to his branch.

act_name: Pakistan Naval Academy (Award of Degrees) Ordinance, 1965
heading: Conferment of degrees on others
title: Conferment of degrees on others
text: 3A.Conferment of degrees on others.___ The Pakistan Naval Academy shall also have the power to confer the degrees referred to in section 3 on any officer of a foreign government on his successfully completing the prescribed course in that Academy.

heading: Power to make Regulations
title: Power to make Regulations
text:
4. Power to make Regulations. The Pakistan Naval Academy may, with the previous approval in writing of the Federal Government, make regulations for carrying out the purposes of this Ordinance.
